answerCheck.reason: A zero baseline makes bar heights proportional to their values, and evenly spaced numerical intervals preserve a consistent scale.

The displayed-height ratio is (250 - 150)/(200 - 150) = 100/50 = 2.0. The actual-value ratio is 250/200 = 1.25.
